chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from Ibrahim ibn Is'haq, from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Sari, from Al-Hasan ibn Ibrahim, from Yazeed ibn Harun, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The farmers are the treasures of the creatures; they cultivate goodness which Allah, Mighty and Majestic, brought forth. And on the Day of Resurrection, they will be the best of people in standing position and the closest in status, and they will be called 'the Blessed ones'.'

key_terms.أَحْسَنُ النَّاسِ مَقَاماً: The best of people in standing position (status)

ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual status of farmers in Shia Islam according to the hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), elevating agriculture from mere labor to a sacred act of stewardship (khilafah) that sustains the community. The title 'al-Mubarakin' (the Blessed) underscores the divine approval of those who transform the earth's potential into tangible sustenance, linking agricultural productivity directly to spiritual merit and high eschatological rank.
